# Provider quota common parity fixtures

Every `*.expected.json` file is generated by invoking the vault's Python
reference (`provider_quota_common.load_policy`, `resolve_label`, and
`has_label`) with the corresponding synthetic `*.input.json`. The generator
uses a temporary directory for the registry file required by `load_policy`;
only the expected fixture files in this directory are written as output.

From the AgentMesh repository root, run:

```sh
python plugins/ops/provider-quota-common/testdata/generate_fixtures.py C:/Users/Keisu/Projects/Notes/obsidian-note
```

The supplied path is the root of the local notes vault containing
`4_Project/Multica-Agent-Strategy/Scripts/provider_quota_common.py`.
